name: Wizer
summary: Wizer teaches security awareness with short animated videos and has a free plan with basic annual training and limited reporting. The paid Boost plan adds adaptive phishing simulations and the full library at $25 per user per year for 25 or more users, falling to $8 at 3,001 or more. Boost is sold on a 3-year term billed annually.

facts.text: Wizer describes its training as 1-minute animated videos based on real-world scams, and says its AI Studio can turn documents or policies into training videos.
The dashboard Progress Report can be exported as a CSV file and shows statistics per user per training with the completion date of each assigned course.
The free plan does not include phishing simulations, SSO, departments and groups, or the full training library.
Online purchase needs at least 25 users. A 1-year term and discounts for education, nonprofit and government buyers go through sales.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Basic annual training videos, Learner Console, limited reporting, automatic learner reminders. No phishing simulations

plans.name: Boost
plans.notes: 3-year term billed annually. Per user per year: $20 at 51+ users, $17 at 101+, $14 at 501+, $12 at 1,001+, $8 at 3,001+. Contact sales above 5,000

hiddenCosts: Boost is sold on a 3-year term billed annually. A 1-year term needs a sales conversation.
Phishing simulations, advanced reporting and the full library are not on the free plan.

contract.dataExport: The Progress Report can be exported as CSV.
